review.note: The date on this record is the imported item's and is the surrender, 2 October 1944. The rising began on 1 August and lasted sixty-three days; a reviewer should decide which date the record should carry and correct it.

title: Warsaw Uprising
summary: The Polish Home Army rose against the German occupation of Warsaw on 1 August 1944, as the Red Army reached the eastern bank of the Vistula, and fought for sixty-three days without effective outside help; the Soviet advance halted, Allied airdrops were few and flown from Italy, and the rising surrendered on 2 October. Between one and two hundred thousand civilians were killed and the city was then demolished street by street on Hitler's order. Its political result was the one the rising had been meant to prevent: the Home Army was destroyed, and the government installed in Poland was the Soviet-sponsored one.
